title: Soul Snack #22: Gary’s First Encounter With Multi-Sensory Perception
excerpt: In this fascinating Soul Snack, Gary reflects on his earliest experiences of multi-sensory perception and how they shaped his journey toward authentic power.
bodyHtml:
In this fascinating Soul Snack, Gary reflects on his earliest experiences of multi-sensory perception and how they shaped his journey toward authentic power. He shares the pivotal moments that first made him aware that there was more to life than the physical world, including a powerful encounter with his grandmother after her transition from the Earth school, and the profound experience of writing The Dancing Wu Li Masters.

Gary recounts how, for much of his early life, he was controlled by frightened parts of his personality—seeking validation through external power, addiction, and a relentless pursuit of self-satisfaction. However, his introduction to quantum physics and his unexpected passion for writing led him to realize that something greater was at play.

As he became more aware of non-physical intelligence and synchronicity, he discovered the joy of creating from love rather than fear.

The key takeaway from this episode is that multi-sensory perception is not something we “achieve”—it is something we awaken to. 

By shifting from self-centered desires to meaningful contributions, we begin to recognize the subtle guidance of the soul, leading us toward deeper fulfillment and authentic power.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:41): The earliest clues that multi-sensory perception was present in Gary’s life.
  • (03:05): How an encounter with physicists at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory sparked Gary’s transformation.
  • (05:31): The unexpected creative process behind The Dancing Wu Li Masters and its deeper meaning.
  • (07:56): How aligning with love and challenging fear create authentic power.
  • (10:19): Why multi-sensory perception is about contribution, not personal gain.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Reflect on moments in your life when you have felt guided by something beyond the material world. Have you ever experienced deep synchronicity, intuitive knowing, or a profound sense of purpose? Write about these moments in your journal. How might shifting your focus from personal gain to service open you to deeper multi-sensory awareness?
